description_en: Removes a tag if the tag is not added to another instance
description_zh: 如果该标签没有绑定到其他实例，则该标签会被删除
kebab_example: aliyun dds untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instances. Valid values:

true: removes all tags from the instances.

false: does not remove all tags from the instances.



Default value: false.

If you specify the TagKey parameter together with this parameter, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑实例上的所有标签，取值：
true：解绑实例上的所有标签。
false：不解绑实例上的所有标签。

默认值为false。
如果同时传入TagKey和本参数，本参数不生效
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The tag keys of the resource
parameters.name: tag_key
